description.en: An example extension from the Leo collection: the live sky where you are, animated by cmux (rain, snow and stars, a spinning sun, floating clouds, a sky that follows the hour, hourly bars that spring), on the New Tab page, in a pane and in a sidebar section.

scopes.net:geocoding-api.open-meteo.com: Find the place you type on the map (Open-Meteo, no account).
scopes.net:api.open-meteo.com: Read the weather and the next 12 hours for that place (Open-Meteo, no account).

optionalScopes.net:get.geojs.io: Only if you turn on Approximate location: look up the city your IP address maps to (GeoJS, no account).

place.title: Place
place.description: A city or town, for example Lisbon or Austin, Texas.

approximateLocation.title: Approximate location from my IP address
approximateLocation.description: When Place is empty, ask GeoJS which city your IP address maps to. Off until you turn it on.

preview.title: Preview a sky
preview.description: Show a made-up sky instead of the live one, to see each animation.
